Reason: The CT image (Figure 2b) shows calcification and narrowing of the right pulmonary artery (indicated by the arrow), which is a characteristic vascular manifestation of Takayasu arteritis. This chronic obstruction explains the patient's symptoms of chest pain and shortness of breath, particularly exacerbated by the hemodynamic demands of pregnancy, rather than an acute embolism or other causes.
